text:
maria: FYI rolling APAC FIPS HSM update just caused keystore replication to drop between eu-central and ap-southeast-1. staging GPUs failing decrypt while joining warm pool.
kevin: seeing the same — warm pool nodes stuck at 'decrypting' during bootstrap, had to drain 6 instances.
ops-bot: Incident created: INT-APAC-KEYSTORE-1739999999 — alerts to infra/sre/security.
olivia: this is expected for a short window but we need audit trail. Are audit logs for cross-region replication still flowing to SIEM?
sumi: quick check: replication succeeded for 3 keys then 504s started. Cloud HSM shows FIPS mode toggled; replication REST calls returning 403 for the mirror account.
jordan: if replication is failing we'll either: 1) block onboarding (what's happening), or 2) temporarily allow replication over a vetted egress path. Security must sign off.
maria: proposal: add a temporary privatelink allowlist for the keystore replication CIDR (10.55.12.0/24) from ap-southeast-1 staging subnets for 30m, then revoke. saves onboarding.
olivia: fine with temporary exception if we: a) log all requests to the SIEM, b) create an auditable ACL change (PR in infra-repo), c) rotate any keys that were accessed during the window.
kevin: can do the ACL PR now. ACL snippet below for the privatelink proxy:

```
# terraform snippet
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "keystore_replica_allow" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.55.12.0/24"]
  security_group_id = var.privatelink_proxy_sg
  description       = "temp allow keystore replication for apac canary"
}
```

sam: also we need to quantify cost impact — staging warm pool kept 6 g4dn.xlarge for ~45m = ~ $X (approx). if we keep larger window that scales.
jordan: agree, prefer a short canary window (20-30m) then revert. We should also fail open gracefully for customer traffic — fallback to eu model variant for now.
maria: who will approve the PR+exception? pinging @olivia for security approval.
olivia: approved under the stated constraints. open a ticket to follow up on making keystore replication tolerant to FIPS toggles (longer-term fix).
kevin: PR opened: https://git.company/infra/PR/1254 — includes ACL change + SIEM policy toggle. doing apply on my mark.
maria: apply in 2m. ops-bot will watch health.
ops-bot: applying terraform plan to staging-privatelink (apply started) — plan shows 1 to add, 0 to change.
sumi: replication resumed within 40s of allowlist add. warm pool nodes completed decrypt and joined.
kevin: confirming: warm pool back to target capacity. rolling back ACL in 28m unless we extend.
jordan: create a postmortem? probably a short incident note + follow-ups: (1) automated KMS replication health check, (2) make keystore client retry/backoff respect FIPS transition responses, (3) improve cross-region audit surfacing.
olivia: add compliance task: ensure the 30m exception is recorded in change log with justification and approver.
maria: filing follow-ups now. closing thread after rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
